risks.name: Vampyric Liminus
risks.description: Slow moving, immortal, Duviri Liminus drain health and energy from allies who get too close.

deviation.name: Double Trouble
deviation.description: Two Necramech Demolishers will attack any Conduit, but their health is reduced.

risks.name: Alluring Arcocanids
risks.description: As Rogue Arcocanids charge attacks, they pull Warframes towards them.

risks.name: Fortified Foes
risks.description: Guardian Eximus units may be encountered, including Guardian Eximus Necramechs.

deviation.name: Coordinated Front
deviation.description: Eximus units support The Fragmented Tide and its final form.

risks.name: Commanding Culverins
risks.description: Rogue Culverins equip weapons that deal 5x Damage to Overguard and Necramechs.

risks.name: Bold Venture
risks.description: Enemies deal -15% Damage and take +15% Damage but gain +15% Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and Fire Rate.

deviation.name: Cache Crash
deviation.description: Consequences of opening a Supply Cache are active from the start and will intensify if the Supply Cache is opened. Failure to open a Supply Cache doubles the kill count required to finish the mission.

risks.name: Dense Fog
risks.description: Efervon gas blankets the level. Enemies may drop filters that can provide a temporary reprieve.

risks.name: Artillery Beacons
risks.description: When killed, Scaldra troops drop artillery beacons that summon bombardments.

deviation.name: Vampire Rock
deviation.description: Flare creates a field that disrupts player abilities while draining energy to boost Flare's health. Flare slowly loses health when no players are in range.

risks.name: Techrot Speed Run
risks.description: All enemies are replaced with Techrot and move much faster.

risks.name: Entanglement
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies endure reduced Movement Speed and Parkour Velocity.

deviation.name: Reinforcements
deviation.description: Reinforcements will arrive during the fight.

risks.name: Scaldra Speed Run
risks.description: All enemies are replaced with Scaldra and move much faster.

risks.name: Balloonfest
risks.description: Scaldra Harbingers are more numerous and attack and move more quickly.

upgrade.title: Toxic Shot
upgrade.description: Add 25% Gas Status Chance to Primary and Secondary weapons.

challenge.title: Make it personal
challenge.description: Kill 150 Scaldra Troops with Melee Weapons

upgrade.title: Friendly Fallout
upgrade.description: Attacks from Specters or Companions have a 25% chance to cause Radiation Status.

upgrade.title: Combo Killer
upgrade.description: Combo Multiplier increases the chance of enemies being susceptible to finishers after a melee hit. 5% per Multiplier Max 65% with Venka Prime.

upgrade.title: Bottled Lightning
upgrade.description: Add 25% Status Damage and Electricity Status Chance to all weapons.
